release-packaging.expect: The real macOS packaging helpers preserve app bundle layout, executable payload/mode, plist/version/exact tagged service URL, license notices and raw service checksum using an owned fixture without launching programs

client-managed-public-release.command: MANAGED_PUBLIC="${MANAGED_PUBLIC:?Set the downloaded release ZIP path}" MANAGED_PUBLIC_SHA="${MANAGED_PUBLIC_SHA:?Set the published service SHA-256}" zsh .groundwork/scripts/client-managed-service.sh
client-managed-public-release.expect: The supplied released app starts from an owned empty cache, uses its embedded public service URL without an asset-URL override, verifies/downloads/starts the service and reaches visible Ready with the published service digest; this exercises the released ZIP, not an arbitrary current-checkout build

context.artifactSource: Caller-supplied release ZIP and expected published service SHA
